name: Continuity means recoverability
statement: Supported operations become available again following ordinary lifecycle interruptions after the machine and required user session resume; service availability must not be misrepresented as uninterrupted computation through suspend, hibernate or power-off.
changePolicy: Process lifecycle machinery is replaceable; honest recoverability and accepted continuity must survive.

provenance.sourceReference: Owner companion recovery design 2026-10-15; Chute Windows v2.6.1 RC1 historical reference
